summary: Lamar County, MS all-steel tower near Purvis; NHLR gives 1957 build with Mississippi Forestry Commission crews and 2022 registration; private land, no public access described.

facts.design: All-steel tower; no model or plan named in the sources read
facts.status_note: Register lists the tower but gives no current condition; the record's 'standing' is not backed by a dated source read
facts.agency: Private Land Owner (administers the site per NHLR); Mississippi Forestry Commission listed as cooperator

access.note: Register lists the location as private land; no public access described in the sources read

events.note: Build year from the NHLR 'Built' field; the description says Mississippi Forestry Commission employees completed construction. The description itself is undated.
Registered May 11, 2022 as US 1571, MS 6; nominated by Jennifer Payne

evidence.supports: tower is six miles west of Purvis
construction completed by Mississippi Forestry Commission employees
evidence.quote: Fire tower construction has been completed by employees of the Mississippi Forestry Commission

evidence.supports: all-steel tower rising 100 feet among longleaf pines
evidence.quote: The all steel tower rises 100 feet among long leaf pines

evidence.supports: cat cracker at Pontiac Refinery visible from 80 feet
evidence.quote: the cat cracker at the Pontiac Refinery was easily visible from a height of eighty feet

evidence.supports: administered by a private land owner
Mississippi Forestry Commission named as cooperator

corrections.why: The NHLR entry gives a build year, a registration date and a photo, but no current condition or standing status, and no dated source read says the tower stands today.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The register gives 379 ft (116 m). 379 ft is 115.5 m, which matches the record's figure; the register has rounded it.
The record lists Private Land Owner. The register names that party as administrator, while the Mississippi Forestry Commission is named as builder and cooperator. The agency fact keeps both.

notes_for_editor: Only one substantive source, the NHLR register entry, plus Wikipedia for the county seat. The 1957 build year is the register's Built field; the description beside it is undated and refers to Forest Service employees 'last week', so the wording may come from an old newspaper report, which is not confirmed. The 100 ft height comes from that same description and is converted to 30.5 m. No staffing, fire, rental or current-condition information was found in two searches and a few page reads; the Mississippi Forestry Commission or Mississippi Digital Library may hold older records. The record's photo already exists (credit Jennifer Payne), so no new photos were added. Status 'standing' is proposed as 'unknown' in corrections.
